title: Parameters

q.description: Search term. Case-insensitive match inside the product name (products) or the order number or customer name (orders). Leave out for everything.
q.title: Search Query

pageSize.description: Rows per page. The server allows at most maxPageSize rows (see the response); a larger value is capped.
pageSize.title: Page Size

pageToken.description: Cursor for the next page: the nextPageToken of the previous response (products) or the pageToken in its Link header (orders). Tokens are opaque and expire after 15 minutes.
pageToken.title: Page Token

description: Query parameters for filtering and paginating orders.
